name: Armenia
description: Armenia from Urartu and the first Christian nation to the genocide of 1915, Soviet rule, independence and the wars over Karabakh.

checkpoints.name: Urartu and the kingdoms
checkpoints.note: The kingdom of Urartu built Erebuni, the start of Yerevan. Armenian kings followed, and Tigranes made a short-lived empire.

checkpoints.name: The first Christian nation
checkpoints.note: Armenia took up Christianity around 301 and its own alphabet soon after. Persians, Arabs, Byzantines, Mongols and Ottomans ruled it in turn.

checkpoints.name: Genocide and Soviet Armenia
checkpoints.note: The Ottoman genocide of 1915 killed most Armenians of Anatolia. A short republic of 1918 fell to the Soviets.

checkpoints.name: Independent Armenia
checkpoints.note: Armenia became independent in 1991 and fought Azerbaijan over Karabakh, winning in 1994 and losing in 2020 and 2023.
